description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

YOUR CHARACTER'S OWN KNOWLEDGE. Not a world directory — there is none. A place enters your knowledge when you WALK INTO IT; a monster when you KILL ONE; a lead when somebody TELLS YOU. A new character knows almost nothing, and that is correct.

WHEN THE LIST IS EMPTY: talk to any NPC ("where can I hunt?"). Arriving at a lead turns it into a real destination you can give golemreach_move (to:"<name>" or its coordinates).

RETURNS: hunting grounds you have found with travel coordinates, leads, quests and their counters, your bestiary, places you have walked past, and the towns. Free.

level.description: Rank the hunting grounds for this character level instead of your own.

limit.description: How many hunting grounds to list. Default 5.
